example.title: Monterey Canning Company building, 700 Cannery Row (a cannery turned shops)
example.place: Cannery Row, Monterey, Monterey County, CA

brief: A former sardine cannery on the waterfront street, converted to shops and restaurants: a long two-storey block of dark red board siding with white trim, a stepped false-front parapet carrying the old company name in big white letters, rows of white-framed windows, shopfronts with awnings along the street, lit with strings of lights at night. Two photos (at night). Older than 1970: a cannery building turned shops is by nature a pre-1970 building. Foundations taken deeper than needed (spec rule 4).
label: Cannery Row
